description: This file defines the CommandInfo class in the OrangeHRM framework, specifically within the console scheduling subsystem. It encapsulates command string and optional input parameters for scheduling commands.

classes.name: CommandInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a scheduled console command, including the command string and optional input arguments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CommandInfo object with a command string and optional ArrayInput parameters.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command string associated with this CommandInfo.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the input parameters associated with this command, if any.
